subject.title: fix(browser): keep guarded CDP sockets on validated endpoints [AI]

question: Should existing Chrome MCP profiles with an explicit remote `cdpUrl` be rejected under restricted CDP policy when Chrome MCP cannot preserve OpenClaw’s validated DNS pin?
rationale: The branch deliberately trades compatibility for a fail-closed SSRF boundary; source and tests show the behavior, but repository policy requires maintainer intent for a settings-breaking compatibility decision.

options.title: Approve fail-closed behavior with upgrade proof

options.title: Preserve compatibility by narrowing the restriction
options.body: Allow the established Chrome MCP attachment path unless a separately approved strict mode or safe transport mechanism is available.
